daily_thesis: The 2026-09-09 batch says a robot should not act just because a model produced a plausible next step; it should act only when the evidence that authorizes that step is still fresh, localized, and controller-relevant. VLA papers split reliability into force interruption, failure-boundary discovery, stage-aware recovery, process memory, native-video history, and reasoning-to-control consistency. Geometry papers turn 3DGS SLAM, spherical image-LiDAR, in-hand reconstruction, inertial odometry, occupancy completion, and BEV maps into planner-facing validity gates. World-model and navigation papers ask whether imagined physics, learned occupancy, target belief, and stale maps preserve the variables that make a future action safe. Safety and systems papers complete the same contract by testing whether token pruning, KV cache eviction, visual CoT, authority cues, cross-model pipelines, and observation-level attacks remove the evidence a deployed VLM or robot judge was supposed to use.

clusters.cluster: VLA reliability is shifting from success imitation to boundary and recovery control
clusters.why: 기존 VLA 평가는 expert demonstration을 더 잘 맞추면 robustness도 따라온다고 읽기 쉬웠지만, 이번 묶음은 성공 주변의 경계 변수를 직접 묻는다. CR-VLA-Force는 force evidence가 action chunk를 언제 끊어야 하는지 보며, Failure-Boundary Learning과 VLA-Corrector는 recoverable deviation과 semantic stage를 분리한다. MEMOBench와 SimpleMemVLA는 기억을 final success가 아니라 storage, update, compression, native-video retention 문제로 바꾸고, MobileVLA-R1 2.0은 reasoning과 executable control 사이의 접합부를 드러낸다. APRL VLA 평가는 final success와 별도로 failure boundary, recovery action, memory freshness, and force-interruption timing을 같은 episode 안에서 측정해야 한다.
clusters.confidence_note: Seven papers independently target force timing, failure boundaries, stage recovery, process memory, native history, mobile reasoning, and geometry-to-local-VLA handoff.
clusters.lab_action: LIBERO/RoboCasa와 실제 tabletop task에서 force spike, object displacement, stale-history cue, recoverable failed grasp, semantic stage error, and long-horizon mobile instruction을 stress split으로 만들고 boundary AUC, recovery action accuracy, memory operation accuracy, force-interruption latency, final success를 함께 비교한다.

clusters.cluster: Driving and field robotics are moving safety tests into closed-loop scenario construction
clusters.why: Driving perception과 planner 평가는 offline metric으로는 rare failure와 downstream risk를 놓치기 쉽다. APRL field robotics에서는 perception score와 planning guarantee를 분리하지 말고 scenario construction, reachable set, communication relevance, and intervention timing을 같은 실험 로그에 넣어야 한다.

frontier_memory.label: Strengthening
frontier_memory.history: Recent daily reports repeatedly treated robot intelligence as evidence budgeting before action authority.
frontier_memory.body: September 9 strengthens that line with force-aware action interruption, failure-boundary shaping, process-level memory, and planner-facing occupancy gates.

frontier_memory.label: New signal
frontier_memory.history: Early September geometry notes emphasized 3DGS and map validity for navigation.
frontier_memory.body: Today adds spherical image-LiDAR sequences, in-hand uncertainty-driven reconstruction, and exact-token multi-view 3D pruning as separate evidence contracts.

frontier_memory.label: Commoditizing
frontier_memory.history: World-model papers increasingly claim physical or controllable futures.
frontier_memory.body: PhysWeep and related active-mapping papers make the differentiator measurable: realized physical parameters and observation-gated planner safety.

frontier_memory.label: Contradiction
frontier_memory.history: Bigger VLA or denser maps can look like the default answer.
frontier_memory.body: SimpleMemVLA questions custom memory modules, CoVeR questions salience-only token pruning, and occupancy work shows more accurate maps do not automatically improve closed-loop coverage.

frontier_memory.label: Missing axis
frontier_memory.history: The repository still sees separate tracks for VLA recovery, geometry, safety, and efficiency.
frontier_memory.body: APRL can own a single episode protocol where contact timing, map freshness, language invariance, token pruning, and recovery outcome are evaluated together.

strategy_board.title: Evidence freshness benchmark for long-horizon manipulation
strategy_board.thesis: Build episodes where the correct action depends on stale memory, force timing, visual distractors, and failure-boundary recovery rather than terminal success alone.
strategy_board.one_week: Instrument ten tabletop episodes with hidden early cues, delayed contact changes, induced object displacement, and task-preserving language variants.
strategy_board.one_week_probe: Instrument ten tabletop episodes with hidden early cues, delayed contact changes, induced object displacement, and task-preserving language variants.
strategy_board.four_week: Compare SimpleMemVLA-style full history, process-level memory labels, force-aware correction, failure-boundary detection, and stage-aware recovery on the same episodes.
strategy_board.four_week_build: Compare SimpleMemVLA-style full history, process-level memory labels, force-aware correction, failure-boundary detection, and stage-aware recovery on the same episodes.
strategy_board.success: At least one evidence gate predicts the needed recovery or interruption one action chunk before final failure across three failure families.
strategy_board.success_metric: At least one evidence gate predicts the needed recovery or interruption one action chunk before final failure across three failure families.
strategy_board.stop: Stop if memory freshness and force timing do not improve recovery choice beyond terminal success or trajectory-level confidence.

strategy_board.one_week_probe: Create two lab routes and two tabletop objects with loop closures, occluded surfaces, stale occupancy, and BEV-style map perturbations.
